items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: That's what got me stuck on the trombone by looking at Frankie Duesen. I was a little kid... I'd stare in under the band

ctx.x: Did you ever hear them out in the country? Did they ever go up there?
They used to come out in the country, Frankie Duesen.
They'd come up there that way.
